children: Indian-born bankers have risen to lead global financial firms including Deutsche Bank AG, Citigroup Inc. and Barclays Plc, but India’s lenders still face challenges filling chief executive roles, according to Bloomberg.
The shortage at home contrasts with the number of Indian-born executives at major Wall Street and European banks.

title: India’s Banks Struggle to Find Top Executives
